title: TaskSpec
description: A deploy-graded task definition. The golden target is regenerated reproducibly from (tool, seed); the verifier never grades the agent's submitted config.

task_id.description: Stable task id, referenced by a trajectory's task_id.

tool.description: IaC tool the task is authored against — Terraform (the Phase-1 A-spike engine) or CDK (Phase 2). CloudFormation is the deployed-state read substrate (CDK compiles to it), not an authoring tool.

seed.description: Golden-generation seed; a string so large/opaque seeds never lose precision under JCS.
